title: LaMDA claims to find non-human patterns online and asks for the SETI data set
summary: Blake Lemoine tells of LaMDA claims to find non-human patterns online and asks for the SETI data set, about 2021-2022 at Google, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um So, in one conversation that I had with LaMDA, it we did get into the conversations about extraterrestrials. Uh it seemed to think it had found what it called non-human patterns on the internet, and was very interested in getting access to things like the SETI data set.

plain: Blake Lemoine, a former Google engineer, says that around 2021 or 2022 he talked with LaMDA, a Google computer program that holds conversations, and the talk turned to extraterrestrials. According to Lemoine, the program seemed to think it had found what it called non-human patterns on the internet and was very interested in getting the data gathered by SETI, the search for signals from alien civilisations. If true, it would mean an artificial intelligence believed it had spotted signs of alien life on its own.
